feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 April 2026 4:10pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 30 April 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure continuing to decline near Denmark with shallow low in the Atlantic slowly approaching southern Ireland.


##Wind##

East or southeast 3 to 5, veering south or southeast 2 to 4 tomorrow morning then increasing south force 5 in the west later.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Fair to start, then occasional showers soon arriving. Areas or mist and isolated fog patches then developing from the south later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers. Becoming moderate or poor later, but very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, but variable 3 or less in the southeast of the area at first, Becoming south or southeast 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the east for a time.


##Weather##

Isolated showers as well as areas of mist and isolated fog patches.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor, but very poor in fog patches.
